Bus.description: Fundamental node where all components attach.

Carrier.description: Energy carriers of buses (e.g. "AC" for alternating current, "DC" for direct current, "hydrogen", or "heat") or technologies of other components (e.g. "wind", "gas turbine", "electrolyser", or "heat pump")

Generator.description: Power generator for the bus carrier it attaches to.

GlobalConstraint.description: Constraints in the optimisation problem that apply to multiple components at once.

Line.description: Lines include distribution and transmission lines, overhead lines and cables.

LineType.description: Standard line types with per length values for impedances.

Link.description: Links are used for controllable directed flows between two or more buses with arbitrary energy carriers (e.g. HVDC links, converters, conversions between carriers).

Load.description: Loads represent a demand at the bus they are connected to (e.g. PQ power consumer).

Process.description: Processes are used for controllable conversion processes involving two or more buses with arbitrary energy carriers (e.g. conversions between carriers).

StorageUnit.description: Storage units enable inter-temporal energy shifting with fixed nominal-energy-to-nominal-power ratio.

Store.description: Stores provide fundamental inter-temporal storage functionality not limited in charging or discharging power.

SubNetwork.description: Subsets of buses and passive branches (i.e. lines and transformers) that are connected (i.e. synchronous areas).
